name: MBT Testimonial
author: Mehmood Baig Mughal

sections.description:
MBT Testimonial 2.0 is a complete update of the original plugin with a modern design and new features — keeping the same simple, clean code style.

Features:
* Slider (Owl Carousel) and Grid layouts
* Star ratings 1–5
* Author photo with initial-avatar fallback
* Custom fields: designation, company, website URL, date
* YouTube & Vimeo video support (lazy embed)
* Groups / taxonomy for filtering
* Featured flag
* Elementor widget with full style controls
* Shortcode: [mbt_testimonial]

Shortcode Examples:

[mbt_testimonial]
[mbt_testimonial layout="grid" columns="3"]
[mbt_testimonial layout="slider" postperpage="6" group="clients"]
[mbt_testimonial featured="1" autoplay="true" speed="5000"]
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/mbt-testimonial/
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. Go to MBT Testimonials in the admin menu and add testimonials
  4. Use shortcode [mbt_testimonial] on any page or post
